# NAME_FORM CLASSIFICATION RULE (applied to the SECOND dot-segment of `code`
# `type-coverage` for all three, so all three get the same classification):
#  1. `mechanism` — the segment names one specific PHP language construct by
#     its own spelling (a keyword, an operator, a named built-in category):
#  2. `subject` — the segment, read alone, names a measurable dimension or

#  3. `judgment` — the segment names a violation, mistake, or recognized
